name: jchat-e2e-web
description: Playwright smoke tests for the Expo Web build (the Maestro flows live in e2e/maestro).

scripts.web:audit: WEB_AUDIT=1 PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=artifacts/web-audit/html PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OPEN=never sh -c "rm -rf artifacts/web-audit/data; playwright test -c web.config.ts web/audit.spec.ts --reporter=html,list; node web/audit-report.mjs"
